questions.question: Which of these actors was the very first to portray Ian Fleming's secret agent James Bond on the big screen, debuting in 1962's Dr. No?
questions.explanation: Sean Connery originated the cinematic role of James Bond in the 1962 film Dr. No, going on to feature in seven Bond films overall.
questions.context: Sean Connery (Scottish actor and producer (1930–2020)): Sir Thomas Sean Connery was a Scottish actor and film producer. Connery was the first actor to portray the fictional British secret agent James Bond in motion pictures, starring in seven Bond films between 1962 and 1983. He originated the role in Dr. No (1962) and continued starring as Bond in the Eon Productions films From Russia with Love (1963), Goldfinger (1964), Thunderball (1965), You Only Live Twice (1967) and Diamonds Are Forever (1971).

questions.question: British television host and former wheelchair basketball competitor Ade Adepitan was born in which country?
questions.explanation: Ade Adepitan is a Nigerian-born British broadcaster and athlete known for presenting documentaries and sports coverage.
questions.context: Ade Adepitan (British television presenter and sportsman (born 1973)): Adedoyin Olayiwola "Ade" Adepitan, PLY is a Nigerian-born British television presenter and wheelchair basketball player. As a presenter, he has hosted a range of travel documentaries and sports programmes for BBC television. Adepitan is a disability advocate and one of the first physically disabled television presenters in the UK, with a career of over twenty years.

questions.question: Which English actress and model started her career in fashion at age 16 before working with brands such as Tommy Hilfiger, Hugo Boss, and Burberry?
questions.explanation: Alice Suki Waterhouse launched her career in the modelling industry as a 16-year-old and modelled for labels including Burberry and Hugo Boss.
questions.context: Suki Waterhouse (English actress, singer, and model (born 1992)): Alice Suki Waterhouse is an English actress, singer, and model. Waterhouse began a career in modelling at the age of 16, and she went on to model for several major fashion labels such as Burberry, Tommy Hilfiger, Hugo Boss, Laura Mercier, and Ferragamo.

questions.question: First introduced in 1553 in novels by Ian Fleming, how many continuation authors had penned authorised James Bond novels or novelisations following Fleming's death?
questions.explanation: After Ian Fleming died in 1964, nine different authors took on writing official James Bond novels and adaptations.
questions.context: James Bond (Media franchise about a British spy): The James Bond franchise focuses on the character of James Bond, a fictional British Secret Service agent created in 1953 by writer Ian Fleming, who featured him in twelve novels and two short-story collections. Since Fleming's death in 1964, nine other authors have written authorised Bond novels or novelisations: Kingsley Amis, Christopher Wood, John Gardner, Raymond Benson, Sebastian Faulks, Jeffery Deaver, William Boyd, Anthony Horowitz and Charlie Higson.
